mechanism: Armodafinil inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing ibuprofen plasma concentrations and GI toxicity risk; ibuprofen may increase armodafinil levels via CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor for increased ibuprofen side effects (GI upset, ulceration); consider alternative analgesic or dose reduction; ensure adequate gastric protection if combination necessary.
